053/**
054 * Facade orchestrating an OpenID Connect Authorization-Code-with-PKCE <i>Relying Party</i> login flow on
055 * top of the {@code juneau-rest-server-auth-oauth} building blocks.
056 *
057 * <p>
058 * A single instance wires the login / callback / logout endpoints plus the session SPI for one IdP.  The
059 * application mounts the three endpoints as explicit {@code @RestGet} methods that delegate to this
060 * facade &mdash; there are no auto-mounted servlet routes (URL ownership stays with the app):
061 *
062 * <p class='bjava'>
063 *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(path=<js>"/auth"</js>)
064 *    <jk>public class</jk> LoginResource <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServlet {
065 *
066 *       <jk>private final</jk> OidcRelyingParty <jf>rp</jf> = OidcRelyingParty.<jsm>create</jsm>()
067 *          .issuer(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://accounts.google.com"</js>))
068 *          .clientId(<js>"web-app"</js>)
069 *          .clientSecret(<jv>env</jv>(<js>"OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET"</js>))
070 *          .redirectUri(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://app.example.com/auth/callback"</js>))
071 *          .scope(<js>"openid"</js>, <js>"profile"</js>, <js>"email"</js>)
072 *          .sessionStore(SignedCookieSessionStore.<jsm>create</jsm>().signingKey(<jv>env</jv>(<js>"SESSION_KEY"</js>)).build())
073 *          .build();
074 *
075 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/login"</js>)
076 *       <jk>public void</jk> login(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
077 *          <jf>rp</jf>.startLogin(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
078 *       }
079 *
080 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/callback"</js>)
081 *       <jk>public void</jk> callback(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
082 *          <jf>rp</jf>.completeLogin(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
083 *       }
084 *
085 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/logout"</js>)
086 *       <jk>public void</jk> logout(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
087 *          <jf>rp</jf>.logout(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
088 *       }
089 *    }
090 * </p>
091 *
092 * <p>
093 * Register {@link #authFilter()} in the servlet filter chain (or {@code AuthFilterChain}) so each request
094 * resolves the session cookie into a {@link ClaimsPrincipal} for {@code RoleBasedRestGuard} /
095 * {@code @Auth Principal}.
096 *
097 * <h2 class='section'>Security</h2>
098 * <ul>
099 *    <li>{@code state} and {@code nonce} are single-use and TTL-bounded (default 5&nbsp;min); a
100 *       missing / replayed value fails the callback.
101 *    <li>PKCE S256 is enforced end-to-end.
102 *    <li>The ID token is validated for signature, {@code iss}, {@code aud}/{@code azp}, {@code exp}, and
103 *       {@code nonce} (see {@link IdTokenValidatorAdapter}).
104 *    <li>The session id is freshly generated on login (no pre-auth fixation).
105 *    <li>Auth responses set {@code Cache-Control: no-store}; tokens are never logged.
106 *    <li>The session cookie is {@code HttpOnly} + {@code Secure} + {@code SameSite} by default.
107 * </ul>
108 *
109 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
110 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SessionStore}
111 *    <li class='jc'>{@link OidcSessionAuthFilter}
112 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/OidcRelyingParty">OIDC Relying Party Login (juneau-rest-server-auth-oidc-rp)</a>
113 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html">OpenID Connect Core 1.0</a>
114 * </ul>
115 *
116 * @since 10.0.0
117 */
118@SuppressWarnings({
119   "java:S1192", // Duplicate string literals are OIDC protocol parameter names and claim names; intentional
120   "java:S3077", // The lazily built metadata/code-flow/validator/JWK/logout-processor caches are volatile references to effectively immutable objects, published once without compound updates
121   "java:S9358" // Ternary chooses a different constructor/null vs value; moving it inside one call is not equivalent.
122})

173      /**
174       * Sets the IdP issuer URL.  OIDC discovery resolves the endpoints + JWKS URI lazily.  Either
175       * this or {@link #metadata(OidcMetadata)} is required.
176       *
177       * <p>
178       * The issuer (and every endpoint discovered from it) must use <js>"https"</js> or target a loopback
179       * host; discovery, JWKS, and token exchanges carry trust-anchor key material and client credentials, so
180       * a plaintext transport to a non-loopback host is rejected.
181       *
182       * @param value The issuer URL.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must use HTTPS or target a loopback host.
183       * @return This object.
184       */
185      public Builder issuer(URI value) {
186         issuer = assertSecureOrLoopback(reqnn("value", value));
187         return this;
188      }

308      /**
309       * Sets the single-use TTL the framework enforces for the login-state ({@code state} / {@code nonce} /
310       * PKCE {@code code_verifier}) association.  Defaults to 5 minutes.
311       *
312       * <p>
313       * This is the RP-enforced policy applied to <b>every</b> consumed record &mdash; both the default
314       * {@link InMemoryLoginStateStore} and any custom {@link #loginStateStore(LoginStateStore) injected store}.
315       * The framework mints {@code expiresAt = createdAt + stateNonceTtl} on the record and re-checks it on
316       * consume, so the ceiling holds even for a shared store that fails to expire an entry.  The
317       * {@code (0, }{@link LoginStateStore#MAX_TTL}{@code ]} cap is enforced here (not only in the default
318       * impl's constructor, which is skipped when a custom store is injected).
319       *
320       * @param value The TTL.  Must be positive and not exceed {@link LoginStateStore#MAX_TTL} (30 minutes).
321       * @return This object.
322       */
323      public Builder stateNonceTtl(Duration value) {
324         reqnn("value", value);
325         req(!value.isZero() && !value.isNegative(), "stateNonceTtl must be positive");
326         req(value.compareTo(LoginStateStore.MAX_TTL) <= 0, "stateNonceTtl must not exceed 30 minutes (was %s)", value);
327         stateNonceTtl = value;
328         return this;
329      }
330
331      /**
332       * Sets an optional custom {@link LoginStateStore} for the pending-login ({@code state} &rarr;
333       * {@code nonce} / PKCE {@code code_verifier} / redirect) association.
334       *
335       * <p>
336       * Optional (unlike {@link #sessionStore(SessionStore)}): when omitted the RP uses the shipped per-JVM
337       * {@link InMemoryLoginStateStore}, and behavior is identical to a single-node deployment.  Supply a
338       * shared (Redis / JDBC) implementation to support a clustered deployment where {@code /login} and
339       * {@code /callback} may land on different nodes without sticky sessions &mdash; the same motivation as a
340       * distributed {@link SessionStore}.
341       *
342       * <p>
343       * <b>The store is secret-bearing</b> ({@code code_verifier} + {@code nonce}); read the
344       * {@link LoginStateStore} security contract before implementing one (TLS + locked-down ACL floor,
345       * encryption-at-rest recommended, never log the payload, atomic {@code GETDEL}/Lua single-use consume).
346       * The framework retains authority over the security-critical decisions regardless of the store: it
347       * re-validates {@code redirectTarget} via {@code safeRelativePath} and re-checks {@code expiresAt}
348       * against its own {@link #clock(Clock) clock} on consume, and enforces the
349       * {@link #stateNonceTtl(Duration)} ceiling &mdash; the store persists the record and enforces single-use,
350       * but is treated as a blob store, not a trusted oracle.
351       *
352       * @param value The login-state store.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
353       * @return This object.
354       */
355      public Builder loginStateStore(LoginStateStore value) {
356         loginStateStore = reqnn("value", value);
357         return this;
358      }

369         sessionTtl = value;
370         return this;
371      }

507      /**
508       * Overrides the clock used for session expiry and the login-state store.  Useful in tests.
509       *
510       * <p>
511       * The login-state {@code expiresAt} is both minted (on {@code startLogin}) and re-checked (on
512       * {@code completeLogin}) against this clock.  In a clustered deployment with a shared
513       * {@link #loginStateStore(LoginStateStore) LoginStateStore}, the ceiling is therefore only as
514       * trustworthy as clock synchronization across nodes; a backend {@code EXPIRE}/TTL is a GC hint, not the
515       * authoritative expiry decision.
516       *
517       * @param value The clock.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
518       * @return This object.
519       */
520      public Builder clock(Clock value) {
521         clock = reqnn("value", value);
522         return this;
523      }

525      /**
526       * Builds the relying party.
527       *
528       * @return A new {@link OidcRelyingParty}.
529       */
530      public OidcRelyingParty build() {
531         if (issuer == null && metadata == null)
532            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires issuer(...) or metadata(...)");
533         if (clientId == null)
534            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires clientId(...)");
535         if (redirectUri == null)
536            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires redirectUri(...)");
537         if (sessionStore == null)
538            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires sessionStore(...)");
539         return new OidcRelyingParty(this);
540      }

575   /**
576    * Constructor.
577    *
578    * @param b The builder.
579    */
580   protected OidcRelyingParty(Builder b) {
581      this.issuer = b.issuer;
582      this.explicitMetadata = b.metadata;
583      this.clientId = b.clientId;
584      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
585      this.redirectUri = b.redirectUri;
586      this.postLogoutRedirectUri = b.postLogoutRedirectUri;
587      this.postLoginRedirect = b.postLoginRedirect;
588      var s = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
589      s.add("openid");
590      s.addAll(b.scopes);
591      this.scopes = u(s);
592      this.sessionStore = b.sessionStore;
593      this.rolesClaim = b.rolesClaim;
594      this.sessionTtl = b.sessionTtl;
595      this.cookieName = b.cookieName;
596      this.cookieSecure = b.cookieSecure;
597      this.cookieHttpOnly = b.cookieHttpOnly;
598      this.cookieSameSite = b.cookieSameSite;
599      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
600      this.authenticationRequestCustomizer = b.authenticationRequestCustomizer;
601      this.idTokenAlgorithms = b.idTokenAlgorithms;
602      this.clockSkewSeconds = b.clockSkewSeconds;
603      this.jwkSet = b.jwkSet;
604      this.injectedJwkSource = b.jwkSource;
605      this.userInfoClaims = u(cp(b.userInfoClaims));
606      this.clock = b.clock;
607      this.stateNonceTtl = b.stateNonceTtl;
608      this.loginStateStore = b.loginStateStore != null
609         ? b.loginStateStore
610         : new InMemoryLoginStateStore(b.stateNonceTtl, b.ephemeralMaxEntries, b.clock);
611   }

617   /**
618    * Begins the login flow: generates {@code state} + {@code nonce} + PKCE verifier, stores them
619    * single-use, and redirects the user-agent to the IdP authorization endpoint.
620    *
621    * @param req The HTTP request.  An optional {@code redirect} query parameter (a safe relative path)
622    *    is remembered as the post-login target.
623    * @param res The HTTP response.
624    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
625    */
626   public void startLogin(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
627      reqnn("req", req);
628      reqnn("res", res);
629      var state = new State().getValue();
630      var nonce = new Nonce().getValue();
631      var verifier = new CodeVerifier();
632      var challenge = CodeChallenge.compute(CodeChallengeMethod.S256, verifier);
633      var redirectTarget = safeRelativePath(req.getParameter("redirect"));
634      var createdAt = clock.instant();
635      var binding = new State().getValue();
636      var pending = new LoginStateStore.PendingLogin(nonce, verifier.getValue(), redirectTarget, createdAt, createdAt.plus(stateNonceTtl), hashBinding(binding));
637      try {
638         loginStateStore.store(state, pending);
639      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
640         // Fail closed before any authorization URL is issued.  Do NOT chain the raw backend exception as the
641         // cause: a shared-store backend may echo the state/code_verifier into its own message, and
642         // AuthenticationException publishes the cause via getCause(), so a raw chain would re-expose the secret.
643         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC login-state store unavailable");
644      }
645      var authUrl = codeFlow().buildAuthenticationUrl(state, challenge, nonce, authenticationRequestCustomizer);
646      noStore(res);
647      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildLoginBindingCookie(binding, stateNonceTtl.toSeconds()));
648      res.sendRedirect(authUrl.toString());
649   }
650
651   /**
652    * Completes the login flow: parses the callback, verifies + consumes {@code state}, exchanges the
653    * code (PKCE), validates the ID token (signature / {@code iss} / {@code aud} / {@code exp} /
654    * {@code nonce}), creates a session, sets the session cookie, and redirects to the application.
655    *
656    * @param req The callback HTTP request (carrying {@code code} + {@code state}).
657    * @param res The HTTP response.
658    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
659    * @throws AuthenticationException If the callback is an error, the state is missing / replayed, or
660    *    ID-token validation fails.
661    */
662   public void completeLogin(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException, AuthenticationException {
663      reqnn("req", req);
664      reqnn("res", res);
665
666      var callbackUri = fullRequestUri(req);
667      AuthenticationResponse parsed;
668      try {
669         parsed = AuthenticationResponseParser.parse(callbackUri);
670      } catch (com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException e) {
671         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OIDC callback could not be parsed");
672      }
673      if (! parsed.indicatesSuccess()) {
674         var err = parsed.toErrorResponse().getErrorObject();
675         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback returned an error: %s", err == null ? "unknown" : err.getCode()); // HTT: err==null branch requires an error response with no error object, which Nimbus never produces
676      }
677      var success = parsed.toSuccessResponse();
678      if (success.getAuthorizationCode() == null)
679         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback contained no authorization code");
680      var code = success.getAuthorizationCode().getValue();
681      var state = success.getState() == null ? null : success.getState().getValue(); // HTT: null state branch: AuthCode response always carries state per PKCE flow; null branch is defensive dead code
682
683      // The binding cookie must be present before the pending login is consumed, so a callback that cannot
684      // complete does not use up the stored state.
685      var bindingValue = readSingleCookie(req, loginBindingCookieName());
686      if (bindingValue == null)
687         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback is not bound to the browser that started the login");
688
689      Optional<LoginStateStore.PendingLogin> consumed;
690      try {
691         consumed = loginStateStore.consume(state);
692      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
693         // Infra failure (backend unreachable) is distinct from a forged/replayed state; reject as unavailable
694         // without leaking the payload (do not chain the raw backend exception as cause).
695         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC login-state store unavailable");
696      }
697      var pending = consumed.orElseThrow(
698         () -> new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback state is missing, expired, or already used"));
699
700      // The login must complete in the same browser that started it: the callback must present the binding cookie
701      // whose hash was stored with the state.
702      if (! bindingMatches(bindingValue, pending.bindingHash()))
703         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback is not bound to the browser that started the login");
704
705      // Fail-closed expiry re-check BEFORE the token exchange: the framework owns the TTL ceiling independently
706      // of the store, so an honest store that failed to expire an over-age record cannot extend usability.  Null
707      // createdAt/expiresAt (a foreign/deserialized blob) is treated as expired, not an NPE->500.
708      if (pending.createdAt() == null || pending.expiresAt() == null || ! clock.instant().isBefore(pending.expiresAt()))
709         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback state is missing, expired, or already used");
710
711      OAuthToken token;
712      try {
713         token = codeFlow().exchange(code, new CodeVerifier(pending.codeVerifier()));
714      } catch (OAuthFlowException e) {
715         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OIDC token exchange failed");
716      }
717      var idToken = token.idToken().orElseThrow(
718         () -> new AuthenticationException("IdP token response contained no id_token"));
719
720      var principal = idTokenValidator().validate(idToken, pending.nonce());
721      principal = maybeBackfillUserInfo(principal, token);
722
723      var subject = principal.getName();
724      var sid = principal.getClaim("sid", String.class);
725      var roles = extractRoles(principal);
726      var now = clock.instant();
727      var session = new OidcSession(
728         new State().getValue(),
729         subject,
730         sid,
731         principal,
732         roles,
733         o(token),
734         now,
735         now.plus(sessionTtl));
736
737      var cookieValue = sessionStore.createSessionCookieValue(session);
738      noStore(res);
739      // The binding cookie is single-use: expire it once the login has completed.
740      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildLoginBindingCookie("", 0));
741      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie(cookieValue, sessionTtl.toSeconds()));
742      // Re-validate the redirect target on consume: a writable/compromised shared store cannot inject an open
743      // redirect.  A failing re-validation falls back to the operator-configured default (not itself re-sanitized).
744      res.sendRedirect(or(safeRelativePath(pending.redirectTarget()), postLoginRedirect));
745   }

747   /**
748    * Logs the user out: invalidates the session, clears the session cookie, and (when the IdP
749    * advertises an end-session endpoint) redirects through it; otherwise redirects to the
750    * post-logout target.
751    *
752    * @param req The HTTP request.
753    * @param res The HTTP response.
754    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
755    */
756   public void logout(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
757      reqnn("req", req);
758      reqnn("res", res);
759      if (neq("POST", req.getMethod())) {
760         res.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED);
761         res.setHeader("Allow", "POST");
762         return;
763      }
764      var cookieValue = readCookie(req);
765      JWT idTokenHint = null;
766      if (cookieValue != null) {
767         idTokenHint = idTokenHintFromSession(cookieValue);
768         sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
769      }
770      noStore(res);
771      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie("", 0));
772
773      var endSession = metadata().endSessionEndpoint();
774      if (endSession != null) {
775         var logoutReq = new LogoutRequest(endSession, idTokenHint, postLogoutRedirectUri, null);
776         res.sendRedirect(logoutReq.toURI().toString());
777      } else {
778         res.sendRedirect(postLogoutRedirectUri != null ? postLogoutRedirectUri.toString() : postLoginRedirect);
779      }
780   }

782   /**
783    * Refreshes the current session's access token using the rotating-refresh-token grant.
784    *
785    * <p>
786    * Replaces the stored refresh token with the one the IdP returns; if the IdP rejects the refresh
787    * (e.g. a rotated token was reused / revoked), the session is invalidated.  Only applies to stores
788    * that retain tokens (server-side); {@link SignedCookieSessionStore} sessions carry no tokens and
789    * yield {@link Optional#empty()}.
790    *
791    * @param req The HTTP request.
792    * @param res The HTTP response (a refreshed session resets the cookie).
793    * @return The refreshed session, or {@link Optional#empty()} if there was nothing to refresh.
794    */
795   public Optional<OidcSession> refresh(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
796      reqnn("req", req);
797      reqnn("res", res);
798      var cookieValue = readCookie(req);
799      if (cookieValue == null)
800         return oe();
801      var existing = sessionStore.lookup(cookieValue);
802      if (existing.isEmpty())
803         return oe();
804      var tokenOpt = existing.get().token();
805      if (tokenOpt.isEmpty())
806         return oe();
807      var oldToken = tokenOpt.get();
808      var refreshTokenOpt = oldToken.refreshToken();
809      if (refreshTokenOpt.isEmpty())
810         return oe();
811
812      OAuthToken refreshed;
813      try {
814         var flowBuilder = OAuthRefreshTokenFlow.create()
815            .tokenEndpoint(metadata().tokenEndpoint())
816            .clientId(clientId)
817            .refreshToken(refreshTokenOpt.get());
818         if (clientSecretSupplier != null) // HTT: false branch (null secret = public client) reachable via refresh path only; no dedicated public-client refresh test
819            flowBuilder.clientSecretSupplier(clientSecretSupplier);
820         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null) // HTT: false branch (no configurator) unreachable in current refresh tests because the test RP always omits a configurator, so this block is never entered in tests
821            flowBuilder.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
822         refreshed = flowBuilder.build().acquire();
823      } catch (OAuthFlowException e) {
824         // Rotating-refresh-token reuse / revocation -> invalidate the session (fail-closed).
825         sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
826         res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie("", 0));
827         return oe();
828      }
829
830      var old = existing.get();
831      var now = clock.instant();
832      var newSession = new OidcSession(
833         new State().getValue(),
834         old.subject(),
835         old.sid(),
836         old.principal(),
837         old.roles(),
838         o(refreshed),
839         old.createdAt(),
840         now.plus(sessionTtl));
841      sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
842      var newCookie = sessionStore.createSessionCookieValue(newSession);
843      noStore(res);
844      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie(newCookie, sessionTtl.toSeconds()));
845      return o(newSession);
846   }

848   /**
849    * Processes an IdP-pushed OpenID Connect back-channel logout token, invalidating the matching
850    * server-side session(s).
851    *
852    * <p>
853    * The logout token is validated via Nimbus's {@link LogoutTokenValidator} (signature against the
854    * JWKS, {@code iss}, {@code aud}, the back-channel {@code events} claim, and the {@code sub} /
855    * {@code sid} presence rule).  Sessions are then revoked by {@code sid} (preferred, single-session)
856    * or {@code sub} (all of a subject's sessions).
857    *
858    * <p>
859    * Requires a {@link SessionStore#supportsServerSideRevocation() server-side-revocable} store
860    * &mdash; the default {@link SignedCookieSessionStore} cannot satisfy back-channel logout because a
861    * stateless cookie is not server-revocable.
862    *
863    * @param logoutToken The raw {@code logout_token} JWT pushed by the IdP.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>
864    *    or blank.
865    * @return The number of sessions invalidated.
866    * @throws AuthenticationException If the logout token fails validation.
867    * @throws IllegalStateException If the configured session store does not support server-side
868    *    revocation.
869    */
870   public int backChannelLogout(String logoutToken) throws AuthenticationException {
871      reqnb("logoutToken", logoutToken);
872      if (! sessionStore.supportsServerSideRevocation())
873         throw new IllegalStateException("Back-channel logout requires a server-side-revocable SessionStore (InMemorySessionStore or a distributed store); the configured store is stateless.");
874      JWT jwt;
875      try {
876         jwt = JWTParser.parse(logoutToken);
877      } catch (ParseException e) {
878         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token could not be parsed");
879      }
880      LogoutTokenClaimsSet claims;
881      try {
882         var verified = logoutTokenProcessor().process(jwt, null);
883         claims = new LogoutTokenClaimsSet(verified);
884      } catch (com.nimbusds.jose.proc.BadJOSEException | com.nimbusds.jose.JOSEException e) {
885         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token validation failed: %s", e.getMessage());
886      } catch (com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException e) {
887         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token claims could not be parsed");
888      }
889      var sid = claims.getSessionID();
890      if (sid != null)
891         return sessionStore.invalidateBySessionId(sid.getValue());
892      var sub = claims.getSubject();
893      if (sub != null) // HTT: false branch (sub==null with sid==null) rejected by LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier which requires at least one of sub or sid; defensive dead code
894         return sessionStore.invalidateBySubject(sub.getValue());
895      return 0;
896   }

930   private OidcMetadata metadata() {
931      var m = metadataCache;
932      if (m != null)
933         return m;
934      synchronized (this) {
935         if (metadataCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
936            return metadataCache;
937         if (explicitMetadata != null) { // HTT: false branch = discovery path; all tests inject .metadata(...) directly so explicitMetadata is always non-null
938            metadataCache = validateEndpoints(explicitMetadata);
939            return metadataCache;
940         }
941         try {
942            var clientBuilder = OidcDiscoveryClient.create().issuer(issuer);
943            if (httpRequestConfigurator != null) // HTT: true branch requires discovery path (no explicit metadata) plus httpRequestConfigurator; all tests inject metadata directly
944               clientBuilder.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
945            metadataCache = validateEndpoints(clientBuilder.build().discover());
946         } catch (IOException | OidcDiscoveryException e) {
947            throw isex(e, "OIDC discovery failed for issuer %s", issuer);
948         }
949         return metadataCache;
950      }
951   }

953   /**
954    * Requires the token-bearing endpoints resolved from metadata (issuer, token, JWKS, authorization, UserInfo, end-session) to use https or a
955    * loopback host, so key material and client credentials are never exchanged over plaintext to a remote host.
956    */
957   private static OidcMetadata validateEndpoints(OidcMetadata m) {
958      if (m.issuer() != null) // HTT: null issuer unreachable; OIDC metadata always carries an issuer
959         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.issuer());
960      if (m.tokenEndpoint() != null)
961         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.tokenEndpoint());
962      if (m.jwksUri() != null)
963         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.jwksUri());
964      if (m.authorizationEndpoint() != null)
965         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.authorizationEndpoint());
966      if (m.userinfoEndpoint() != null)
967         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.userinfoEndpoint());
968      if (m.endSessionEndpoint() != null)
969         assertSecureOrLoopback(m.endSessionEndpoint());
970      return m;
971   }

990            b.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);

1015   private JWKSource<SecurityContext> jwkSource() {
1016      var s = jwkSourceCache;
1017      if (s != null)
1018         return s;
1019      synchronized (this) {
1020         if (jwkSourceCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
1021            return jwkSourceCache;

1023            jwkSourceCache = injectedJwkSource;
1024         } else if (jwkSet != null) { // HTT: false branch (no jwkSet → use JWKS URI from discovery) requires a live IdP and no injected jwkSet; all tests inject jwkSet
1025            jwkSourceCache = new ImmutableJWKSet<>(jwkSet);
1026         } else {
1027            try {
1028               jwkSourceCache = JWKSourceBuilder.<SecurityContext>create(metadata().jwksUri().toURL(), new JwksResourceRetriever()).outageTolerant(false).build();
1029            } catch (MalformedURLException e) {
1030               throw isex(e, "Invalid JWKS URI: %s", metadata().jwksUri());
1031            }
1032         }
1033         return jwkSourceCache;

1037   /**
1038    * Builds (and caches) the JWT processor used to validate back-channel logout tokens.
1039    *
1040    * <p>
1041    * Nimbus's {@link LogoutTokenValidator} hardcodes a {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} internally and
1042    * exposes no clock hook, so we drive an equivalent {@link DefaultJWTProcessor} directly: the JWS type
1043    * verifier replicates {@code LogoutTokenValidator}'s default (accept untyped, {@code logout+jwt}, or
1044    * {@code JWT}), and the claims verifier is a {@link ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} that sources
1045    * "now" from {@link #clock}.  With {@link Clock#systemUTC()} the behavior is identical to stock
1046    * {@code LogoutTokenValidator}.
1047    */
1048   private ConfigurableJWTProcessor<SecurityContext> logoutTokenProcessor() {
1049      var p = logoutTokenProcessorCache;
1050      if (p != null)
1051         return p;
1052      synchronized (this) {
1053         if (logoutTokenProcessorCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
1054            return logoutTokenProcessorCache;
1055         Set<JWSAlgorithm> algs = idTokenAlgorithms != null
1056            ? new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList(idTokenAlgorithms))
1057            : new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList(JWSAlgorithm.RS256, JWSAlgorithm.ES256));
1058         var keySelector = new JWSVerificationKeySelector<SecurityContext>(algs, jwkSource());
1059         var expectedIssuer = new Issuer(metadata().issuer().toString());
1060         var processor = new DefaultJWTProcessor<SecurityContext>();
1061         processor.setJWSTypeVerifier(new DefaultJOSEObjectTypeVerifier<>(LogoutTokenValidator.TYPE, JOSEObjectType.JWT, null));
1062         processor.setJWSKeySelector(keySelector);
1063         @SuppressWarnings({
1064            "unchecked" // ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier conforms to JWTClaimsSetVerifier<SecurityContext>; Nimbus's raw type forces an unchecked conversion here.
1065         })
1066         JWTClaimsSetVerifier<SecurityContext> claimsVerifier = new ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier(expectedIssuer, new ClientID(clientId), clock);
1067         processor.setJWTClaimsSetVerifier(claimsVerifier);
1068         logoutTokenProcessorCache = processor;
1069         return logoutTokenProcessorCache;
1070      }
1071   }

1073   private ClaimsPrincipal maybeBackfillUserInfo(ClaimsPrincipal principal, OAuthToken token) {
1074      if (userInfoClaims.isEmpty())
1075         return principal;
1076      var endpoint = metadata().userinfoEndpoint();
1077      if (endpoint == null)
1078         return principal;
1079      var missing = userInfoClaims.stream().anyMatch(c -> ! principal.hasClaim(c));
1080      if (! missing)
1081         return principal;
1082      try {
1083         var http = new UserInfoRequest(endpoint, new BearerAccessToken(token.accessToken())).toHTTPRequest();
1084         http.setConnectTimeout(USERINFO_TIMEOUT_MS);
1085         http.setReadTimeout(USERINFO_TIMEOUT_MS);
1086         http.setFollowRedirects(false);
1087         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
1088            httpRequestConfigurator.accept(http);
1089         var resp = UserInfoResponse.parse(http.send());
1090         if (! resp.indicatesSuccess())
1091            return principal;
1092         var ui = resp.toSuccessResponse().getUserInfo().toJSONObject();
1093         if (neq(principal.getName(), ui.get("sub")))
1094            return principal;  // The UserInfo subject must match the ID-token subject.
1095         var merged = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>(principal.getClaims());
1096         for (var c : userInfoClaims)
1097            if (! merged.containsKey(c) && ui.containsKey(c))
1098               merged.put(c, ui.get(c));
1099         return new ClaimsPrincipal(principal.getName(), merged);
1100      } catch (IOException | com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException | RuntimeException e) {
1101         return principal;  // UserInfo backfill is best-effort; never fail the login on it.
1102      }
1103   }

1105   private Set<String> extractRoles(ClaimsPrincipal principal) {
1106      var v = principal.getClaims().get(rolesClaim);
1107      if (v == null)
1108         return Collections.emptySet();
1109      var out = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
1110      if (v instanceof String v2) {
1111         for (var piece : v2.split("\\s+"))
1112            if (! piece.isBlank())
1113               out.add(piece);
1114      } else if (v instanceof Collection<?> v2) {
1115         for (var item : v2)
1116            if (item instanceof String item2)
1117               out.add(item2);
1118      }
1119      return out;
1120   }

1122   private String buildSetCookie(String value, long maxAgeSeconds) {
1123      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1124      sb.append(cookieName).append('=').append(value);
1125      sb.append("; Path=/");
1126      sb.append("; Max-Age=").append(maxAgeSeconds);
1127      if (cookieHttpOnly)
1128         sb.append("; HttpOnly");
1129      if (cookieSecure)
1130         sb.append("; Secure");
1131      if (cookieSameSite != null) // HTT: false branch requires null cookieSameSite, which the builder's reqnb guard prevents
1132         sb.append("; SameSite=").append(cookieSameSite);
1133      return sb.toString();
1134   }

1136   /**
1137    * Best-effort extraction of the {@code id_token_hint} for the RP-initiated logout request from the
1138    * session referenced by the given cookie value.  Returns <jk>null</jk> when the session, its token,
1139    * or its id_token is absent, or when the id_token cannot be parsed.
1140    */
1141   private JWT idTokenHintFromSession(String cookieValue) {
1142      var session = sessionStore.lookup(cookieValue);
1143      if (session.isEmpty())
1144         return null;
1145      var token = session.get().token();
1146      if (token.isEmpty())
1147         return null;
1148      var idt = token.get().idToken();
1149      if (idt.isEmpty()) // HTT: requires OAuthToken with no id_token; code-exchange always produces one when idToken is set on the stub, and the field is final
1150         return null;
1151      try {
1152         return JWTParser.parse(idt.get());
1153      } catch (ParseException e) {
1154         return null;  // HTT - best-effort hint only
1155      }
1156   }
1157
1158   private String readCookie(HttpServletRequest req) {
1159      return readCookie(req, cookieName);
1160   }
1161
1162   private String loginBindingCookieName() {
1163      // The __Host- prefix makes browsers refuse a cookie set by a sibling host or with a Domain attribute.
1164      return (cookieSecure ? "__Host-" : "") + cookieName + "_LOGIN";
1165   }
1166
1167   private String buildLoginBindingCookie(String value, long maxAgeSeconds) {
1168      // SameSite=Lax regardless of the session-cookie setting: the IdP callback is a cross-site top-level navigation.
1169      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1170      sb.append(loginBindingCookieName()).append('=').append(value);
1171      sb.append("; Path=/; Max-Age=").append(maxAgeSeconds).append("; HttpOnly");
1172      if (cookieSecure)
1173         sb.append("; Secure");
1174      sb.append("; SameSite=Lax");
1175      return sb.toString();
1176   }
1177
1178   private static String hashBinding(String value) {
1179      try {
1180         return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(
1181            MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
1182      } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
1183         throw new IllegalStateException(e);  // HTT: SHA-256 is always available
1184      }
1185   }
1186
1187   private static boolean bindingMatches(String cookieValue, String expectedHash) {
1188      if (cookieValue == null || expectedHash == null)
1189         return false;
1190      return MessageDigest.isEqual(
1191         hashBinding(cookieValue).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
1192         expectedHash.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
1193   }
1194
1195   private static String readCookie(HttpServletRequest req, String name) {
1196      var cookies = req.getCookies();
1197      if (cookies == null)
1198         return null;
1199      for (var c : cookies)
1200         if (eq(name, c.getName()) && c.getValue() != null && ! c.getValue().isBlank())
1201            return c.getValue();
1202      return null;
1203   }
1204
1205   /** Returns the cookie value only when exactly one cookie of that name is present; otherwise <jk>null</jk>. */
1206   private static String readSingleCookie(HttpServletRequest req, String name) {
1207      var cookies = req.getCookies();
1208      if (cookies == null)
1209         return null;
1210      String found = null;
1211      for (var c : cookies) {
1212         if (! eq(name, c.getName()))
1213            continue;
1214         if (found != null)
1215            return null;
1216         found = c.getValue() == null || c.getValue().isBlank() ? "" : c.getValue();
1217      }
1218      return found == null || found.isEmpty() ? null : found;
1219   }

1221   private static void noStore(HttpServletResponse res) {
1222      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
1223      res.setHeader("Pragma", "no-cache");
1224   }

1226   private static URI fullRequestUri(HttpServletRequest req) {
1227      var url = new StringBuilder(req.getRequestURL());
1228      var qs = req.getQueryString();
1229      if (qs != null) // HTT: false branch (no QS) would cause Nimbus to fail to parse the callback; all test callbacks include query params
1230         url.append('?').append(qs);
1231      return URI.create(url.toString());
1232   }

1234   /**
1235    * Returns the value only if it is a safe app-relative path (defeats open-redirect via the
1236    * {@code redirect} parameter).
1237    */
1238   private static String safeRelativePath(String value) {
1239      if (isBlank(value))
1240         return null;
1241      if (! value.startsWith("/"))
1242         return null;
1243      if (value.startsWith("//") || value.contains("\\") || value.contains("://"))
1244         return null;
1245      for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
1246         var ch = value.charAt(i);
1247         if (ch <= 0x20 || ch == 0x7f)
1248            return null;
1249      }
1250      return value;
1251   }

1253   /**
1254    * A {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} whose {@code exp} window is evaluated against an injected
1255    * {@link Clock} instead of {@code new Date()}.
1256    *
1257    * <p>
1258    * {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} extends Nimbus's {@link DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier}, which exposes
1259    * an overridable {@link DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier#currentTime() currentTime()} hook &mdash; so this is
1260    * a one-method override that injects the clock without cloning any Nimbus claim-checking logic.  With
1261    * {@link Clock#systemUTC()} the behavior is identical to stock Nimbus.
1262    */
1263   private static final class ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier extends LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier {
1264
1265      private final Clock clock;
1266
1267      ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier(Issuer issuer, ClientID clientId, Clock clock) {
1268         super(issuer, clientId);
1269         this.clock = clock;
1270      }
1271
1272      @Override /* DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier */
1273      protected Date currentTime() {
1274         return Date.from(clock.instant());
1275      }
1276   }
1277}
